svg.title: Known-best packing of 146 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=146 construction, never the source witness: Evan Daniel's regularizer's view of it, its contacts re-solved exactly at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 820b9ff rational centre/half-angle certificate converted exactly from a checkout at the pin whose bytes have the digests the packet records, and equal there to the source's own corners Witness/v2; no upstream byte is retained. Finite construction feasibility only; no local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.
